input.command:
cd /work && python3 /app/act.py '{"turn_deg": 90, "move_m": 0}' && python3 /app/act.py '{"turn_deg": 45, "move_m": 0}'
echo "=== obs_0007 (origin, h=270) west wall check ==="
python3 -c "
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, math
im=np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0007.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
fl=(abs(R-G)<25)&(R>120)&(R<190)&(G>110)&(B>90)&(B<165)&(R-B>15)
h=270.0; hr=math.radians(h); F=np.array([math.sin(hr),math.cos(hr)]); Rt=np.array([math.cos(hr),-math.sin(hr)])
for u in range(0,512,32):
    c=np.nonzero(fl[:,u])[0]
    if not len(c) or c.min()<=257: print(u,'none'); continue
    v=int(c.min()); D=396.8/(v-256.); L=D*(u-256)/256.
    w=D*F+L*Rt; print('u%3d v%3d -> x=%6.2f y=%6.2f'%(u,v,w[0],w[1]))
" 2>/dev/null
